name: Cinematic Documentary
summary: Low-key, atmospheric imagery in layered depth with slow deliberate camera movement, restrained condensed type and designed silence. The camera does the narrating.

identity.visual_language: layered atmospheric planes, light and haze, restrained type
identity.cinematic_character: filmic: contrast, bloom and grain; shallow-focus emphasis
identity.photography_style: low-key, single dominant light source, wide establishing then detail
identity.composition_philosophy: subject off-centre with deep space; the frame breathes
identity.environment: specific places or media, not abstract voids

palette.contrast_strategy: light type on near-black; accent reserved for the single thing being looked at

typography.scale_and_hierarchy: sparse; titles small and placed, never centred slabs

composition.principles: rule-of-thirds off-centre subject, long depth, strong foreground/background separation
composition.negative_space: generous and purposeful (darkness is part of the shot)
composition.layering_and_depth: 6-layer depth: plate, midground, subject, haze, foreground particles, vignette

motion.grammar: The camera moves, objects barely do. Long eased moves, slow dissolves, and sound doing half the work.

transitions.continuity: light direction and horizon carry across

camera.language: slow push-ins, descents, lateral tracks, parallax between planes, rack focus
camera.lens_character: long-lens compression for detail, wide for scale

motion.object_movement: ambient drift, particles in light shafts
motion.kinetic_typography: minimal; fade-in lines with long tracking
motion.particles: dust, plankton or ash in the light
motion.light_behaviour: slow breathing of light; rays shift with camera
motion.stillness_policy: Stillness is expected between events; keep grain and drift alive.

audio_direction.narration: low, measured, 0.95-1.05x (am_michael or similar documentary voice)
audio_direction.music: sparse drone or piano, ducked under voice
audio_direction.sfx: layered environment beds, designed hits at reveals

rendering.strategy: Layered 2.5D in HyperFrames over generated or licensed plates; grain and bloom as overlays; camera via Studio.space.
rendering.resource_notes: Photographic plates normally need a provider or licensed footage; procedural gradients and particles are the offline stand-in and look flatter.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Without real or generated plates, procedural depth reads flat.
Dark grading hides compression banding; check gradients.
example_scenes: A vertical descent through layered water with light shafts and one small label per depth.
